capabilities: Hide headings, paragraphs or words during recall sessions
Schedule revisions with fixed confidence grades or SM-2
Track due notes, streaks and history on a dashboard
Set exam deadlines that shorten review gaps
Export and update notes as Anki cards via AnkiConnect
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Review data is stored as YAML properties inside the notes themselves, with no cloud service.
intentEvidence: Flashcard apps (like Anki) chop your notes into tiny, out-of-context cards.
motivation: The author wanted to keep recall practice in the context of the real note rather than fragmenting notes into flashcards.
problem: Flashcard apps break notes into decontextualized cards, and Obsidian has no built-in way to actively recall and schedule whole notes.

relations.evidence: Echo Recall talks to Anki through it

requires.name: Anki desktop with the AnkiConnect add-on

summary: Active-recall study tool that hides parts of your notes during revision sessions and schedules them with spaced repetition.
